title: Battery Replacement Warranties: Active Batteries per Vehicle
content:
## Rule

Battery Replacement Warranties are aggregated per vehicle. The number of the vehicle's battery warranties in status active on the purchase date, together with the new battery, may not exceed the limit on active battery warranties per vehicle of the new battery's line: one for every line except the Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery, which allows two for the dual-battery application.

When a paid battery purchase replaces a battery whose warranty is still active outside any warranty claim, the old warranty is closed as removed first and only then is the new battery sold; a free replacement or a prorated adjustment closes or continues the old warranty under its own rule instead.

## The count, restated

- **What is counted:** the vehicle's battery warranties whose status is active on the purchase date of the new battery.
- **What is added:** the new battery itself, counted as one.
- **What it is compared with:** the per-vehicle limit of the line being sold, not of the line already fitted.
- **Result:** the total may not exceed that limit.

| New battery's line | Limit per vehicle | Active warranties on the vehicle on the purchase date | Total with the new battery | Within the limit? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any line other than Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 1 | 0 | 1 | Yes |
| any line other than Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 1 | 1 | 2 | No |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 2 | 1 | 2 | Yes |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 2 | 2 | 3 | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A vehicle carries one active Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery warranty and the customer pays for a new Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery outside any warranty claim. The new battery replaces a battery whose warranty is still active, so the old warranty is closed as removed and only then is the new battery sold; once the old warranty is no longer active the count is nil, and the new battery brings the total to one, within the limit of one.
- A dual-battery truck carries one active Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery warranty and a second Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery is sold for the second position. The total is two, within that line's limit of two.
- A battery that fails and is replaced free, or is adjusted against a new battery bought with a prorated credit, is not a paid purchase outside a warranty claim: the old warranty is closed or continued under the rule for that free replacement or that adjustment.
